reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Update AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (#6638) #6638 (Amanuel Engeda)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs get updated AMIFamily handling after upgrading to 1.0.0, so node provisioning from those AMIs should be verified.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading to 1.0.0, verify that nodes launched from non-AL2023 AMIs are still provisioned as intended.

proposed.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 updates AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (bugfix #6638), so environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs will see changed AMIFamily handling after upgrading.
